findings_message: Static correctness review of frozen completion source 50fbfce7d11bb881ec204f61eb2d3032dab0cdc94c7cc01a222121b19d5c8ae5 (no physical run): HIGH—capture readiness remains blocked. (1) W1/W2 completeness is materially under-specified in m1_trust_region_stage1.rs:1800-1889: W1 does not require factor A/V/sigma, factor-application identities/count, p0 full+free ordered traces, stage masks, or live exit; W2 does not require h0/h1/inverse_t/denominator/z, stage masks/lineage, exact norm ordering/content, or stage-dependent absence of p2 full/free. Both accept any same-role 21-element norm trace without checking coordinate sequence/value/square/running-sum joins. Terminal completeness only requires some refusal; kind/reason/ordinary-vs-Dot2 stage and actual-branch-dependent reached/unreached fields are not validated. unreached_is_natural_only is unconditional true, so null still conflates naturally unreached and uninstrumented. witness_complete is the weaker predicate, while IPC uses reached_prefix_complete; the misleading fallback field remains. Expected guard is correctly separate from completeness, but actual typed terminal branch must drive stage validation. (2) W3 completeness in m1_coupled_tests.rs:151-171 requires only one terminal flag/id plus no truncation/error. It can report complete with absent/wrong context, usize::MAX call id, wrong site/role/map, or missing proposal/FD provenance. Concrete uncovered actual call sites remain validate_with_q_guard constructor at m1_coupled.rs:1154; check_m1_probe_side next/current at 2015/2044; handled tie screen at 2093. Existing contexts are generic/misclassified: core_reservoir_constructor always trial_candidate/full/full_identity; FD screens omit column/side; reduced reconstruction records generic reconstructed/reduced_request_map rather than actual logical→physical map; phase join is generic phase_selection/full_identity. Vegetation derivative/residual emitters carry event ids, but no frozen field-to-hook table/reachability proof binds their production callers/unreachability. Exact error-carried event identity and final outer-return join are accepted improvements, and obsolete pending-terminal API is absent. (3) No accepted prospective worst-case JSON byte proof exists. M1_MH_REFUSAL_CAP=1024 plus post-serialization MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES assert is not the required bound over all schema fields/events; no final schema coverage table exists. MEDIUM—default-off path now avoids allocation/norm trace work, per-face reset prevents stale lineage, work serializer includes all eight BVLS05 counters, and W2 p0/p1 zero-lambda norms are captured at actual calls without arithmetic changes. However observer scopes add atomic-load/RAII overhead to ordinary constructor paths; no build/runtime evidence establishes noninterference. Final format PASS is useful, but no-run timed out at65s, four new LSE diagnostics remain, no authenticated final binary exists, and no physical captures ran. Disposition: safe to preserve only as detached, recoverable partial instrumentation with HOLD and slots W1/W2/W3=0/0/0. No capture approval, no diagnosis, no source adoption approval.
